objective: Bootstrap the Runtime engineering capability itself.
objectives: Verify whether the Runtime can modify its own kernel.
If autonomous kernel modification is unavailable, identify the exact missing capability.
Generate an Engineering Backlog describing the minimum implementation required.
If the engineering provider exists, invoke it and apply the generated patch.
Rebuild, revalidate and repeat until completion or until a blocking capability is formally evidenced.
definitionOfDone: Runtime Kernel repaired OR blocking capability formally evidenced with an engineering backlog and patch plan.
